shortDescription: Genasys Inc. (NASDAQ: GNSS), the global leader in Protective Communications®, today announced new and follow-on Long Range Acoustic Device®(LRAD) orders totaling $3.0 million from the United States and other countries. children: orders totaling $3.0 million from the United States and other countries. Domestic and international department, agency, and enterprise customers are slated to deploy the LRADs in military, law enforcement, critical infrastructure protection, and wildlife preservation applications.

“Increasing geopolitical unrest and regional conflicts are driving LRAD interest and orders from defense departments and police agencies throughout the world,” said Genasys Chief Executive Officer, Richard Danforth. “Military and law enforcement demand for LRAD systems remains high in light of higher global defense, homeland security, and public safety budgets.”

Mr. Danforth continued, “One of our strongest growth opportunities is critical infrastructure protection. Enterprise and government entities are boosting the protection of critical infrastructure in the face of rising political opposition, vandalism, and violence. Over the past several months, we have seen a steady expanding pipeline for LRAD systems in the U.S. and abroad as customers make capital investments to enhance communication, safety, and security. Our pipeline has never been stronger, and we remain on track for record fiscal year revenue and profitability.”

Long Range Acoustic Devices broadcast audible voice messages with exceptional clarity from close range out to 5,000 meters. Rugged, reliable, and easy to operate, LRADs are used to warn and notify, direct and command, establish large safety zones, prevent misunderstandings, determine intent, deescalate dangerous situations, and save lives.

Genasys is the global leader in Protective Communications®, providing the most comprehensive portfolio of preparedness, response, and analytics software and hardware solutions available. The Company’s Long Range Acoustic Device® (LRAD®) and Protect Platform, which includes Genasys Protect® and Genasys Evertel®, are designed around one premise: ensuring organizations and public safety agencies are Ready when it matters®. Protecting people and saving lives for over 40 years, Genasys covers more than 155 million people in all 50 states and in over 100 countries worldwide. For more information, visit genasys.com.
